sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: Analytical performance requires the software to correctly and reliably generate its intended output from input data, the essence of measurement reliability.

sources.title: IVDR — in-vitro diagnostic software (Regulation (EU) 2017/746)
sources.why: Demands analytical performance evidence so diagnostic outputs interpreting specimen values like blood glucose are measured reliably.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Sets quality and safety dimensions for non-device health apps, covering the reliability of the software's measurements and outputs.
